hab: Revived in Bureau labs; once, the floor of an iron sea
bio: A trilobite in riveted plate, dug out of a shale bed and brought back by a Bureau lab that has regretted it ever since. It builds a library in every town it crawls through, then bills the town for the bricks.
note: Gives it all away. Invoices the giving.

cry.name: placeholder: a rusty clank from the bottom of an old sea (Claude's draft)
